channel.title: CipherVerse — Cryptography & Cybersecurity Blog
channel.description: In-depth cryptography tutorials, mathematical breakdowns, steganography techniques, and cryptanalysis guides.

item.title: Caesar Cipher & ROT13: The Complete Mathematical & Cryptanalysis Guide
item.description: An exhaustive educational breakdown of the Caesar cipher: historical Roman origins, modular arithmetic formulas in Z26, ROT13 involution, automated Chi-Square frequency cryptanalysis, and runnable Python cracking scripts.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Vigenère Cipher: Polyalphabetic Cryptanalysis, Kasiski Examination & Index of Coincidence
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the Vigenère Cipher: Bellaso origins, Tabula Recta matrix arithmetic in ℤ₂₆, the collapse of single-letter frequency analysis, the Kasiski test, Friedman’s Index of Coincidence, and runnable Python auto-crackers.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Atbash Cipher: Ancient Biblical Cryptography, Involution Symmetry & Modern Decoders
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the Atbash Cipher: ancient Hebrew scribal origins in the Book of Jeremiah, involution symmetry f(f(x)) = x, affine cipher equivalence in ℤ₂₆, mirror frequency analysis, and runnable Python implementations.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Affine Cipher: Modular Multiplicative Inverses, Coprimality & Algebraic Cryptanalysis
item.description: An exhaustive mathematical breakdown of the Affine Cipher: linear congruences in ℤ₂₆, the coprimality condition gcd(a, 26) = 1, calculating modular inverses with the Extended Euclidean Algorithm, and two-point algebraic cryptanalysis.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Rail Fence Cipher: The Complete Guide to Zig-Zag Transposition & Cryptanalysis
item.description: An exhaustive educational breakdown of the Rail Fence Cipher: transposition vs. substitution, triangular wave periodicity P = 2(d - 1), worked zig-zag matrix traces, preserved frequency distributions, anagramming, and runnable Python auto-crackers.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Bifid Cipher: Polybius Fractionation, Delastelle’s Breakthrough & Modern Diffusion
item.description: An exhaustive educational breakdown of the Bifid Cipher: Félix Delastelle’s 1901 invention, Polybius square coordinate decomposition, horizontal stream fractionation, Claude Shannon’s concept of diffusion, and runnable Python auto-solvers.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Bacon's Cipher & Steganography: The Complete Binary Encoding & Cryptanalysis Guide
item.description: An exhaustive educational breakdown of Sir Francis Bacon's 1605 bilateral cipher: information theory principles (ceil(log2(26)) = 5), 24-letter vs. 26-letter alphabets, typeface steganography (Font A/B), worked carrier trace matrices, and standalone Python auto-steganography suite.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: Simple Monoalphabetic Substitution Cipher: Key Spaces, Frequency Analysis & Algorithmic Solvers
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the monoalphabetic substitution cipher: the 26! (4.03 × 10²⁶) permutation key space, Al-Kindi's 9th-century discovery of frequency analysis, n-gram statistical cryptanalysis, hill-climbing optimization, and runnable Python auto-solvers.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: A1Z26 Cipher & Numerical Encoding: The Mathematics of Coordinate Indexing & Prefix-Free Codes
item.description: An exhaustive academy guide to A1Z26: the vital distinction between encoding and encryption, the mathematical proof of delimiter necessity, prefix-free Kraft inequality analysis, algebraic layering in Affine/Hill ciphers, and dynamic programming ambiguity solvers in Python.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: The Enigma Machine: Rotor Permutations, The Reflector Involution & Turing's Bombe
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the WWII Enigma machine: Arthur Scherbius's electro-mechanical circuit architecture, the mathematical proof of the Reflector involution, the fatal non-self-encrypting vulnerability, Polish cycle cryptanalysis, and runnable Python simulators.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: The Turing Bombe: Crib Graphs, Welchman's Diagonal Board & Deductive Contradiction
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the electromechanical Turing Bombe: Alan Turing and Gordon Welchman's Bletchley Park cryptanalysis of Enigma, menu graph theory, the Diagonal Board involution theorem, and runnable Python crib solvers.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: The Typex Cipher Machine: 5-Rotor Assemblies, Multi-Notch Irregular Stepping & Axis Cryptanalysis Failure
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of Britain's WWII Typex cipher machine: Wing Commander O.G.W. Lywood's 5-rotor architecture, stator permutation discs, multi-notch irregular stepping kinematics, why it remained unbroken by Axis codebreakers, and runnable Python simulators.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: AES-256 Block Cipher: Galois Fields GF(2⁸), Substitution-Permutation Networks & Modern Modes
item.description: An exhaustive academic breakdown of the Advanced Encryption Standard (Rijndael): Substitution-Permutation Networks, finite field arithmetic in GF(2⁸), SubBytes S-Box inversion, ShiftRows and MixColumns diffusion, Key Expansion, block cipher modes (ECB, CBC, CTR, GCM), and runnable Python implementations.
item.author: CipherVerse Cryptography Academy

item.title: The Cryptographer's Journey: From Ancient Caesar Ciphers to Modern AES-256
item.description: Explore the 2,000-year history of cryptographic evolution: how simple monoalphabetic substitution ciphers collapsed under frequency analysis, paving the way for polyalphabetic machines and modern Rijndael block ciphers.
item.author: CipherVerse Research Lab

item.title: Steganography Masterclass: How to Conceal Secrets in Digital Images and Audio
item.description: A practical, mathematical guide to modern steganography: LSB spatial embedding, discrete cosine transforms (DCT), high-frequency audio phase encoding, and forensic steganalysis detection.
item.author: CipherVerse Security Team

item.title: How Public-Key Cryptography Works: The Mathematics of RSA & Prime Factorization
item.description: An intuitive breakdown of asymmetric cryptography: trapdoor one-way functions, Euler’s Totient Theorem, modular exponentiation, and how 2048-bit RSA secures HTTPS across the world.
item.author: CipherVerse Research Lab
